title: Penguin reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Penguin body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="20" ry="24" fill="#3B4A6B"/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="13" ry="16" fill="#E8EEF7"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="35" r="15" fill="#3B4A6B"/>
  <!-- White face patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="37" rx="10" ry="9" fill="#E8EEF7"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="34" r="2.5" fill="#1A1F2E"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="34" r="2.5" fill="#1A1F2E"/>
  <circle cx="45.8" cy="33.2" r="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="55.8" cy="33.2" r="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <polygon points="47,40 53,40 50,45" fill="#F5A623"/>
  <!-- Wings / flippers holding book -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="60" rx="6" ry="14" fill="#3B4A6B" transform="rotate(-15 30 60)"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="60" rx="6" ry="14" fill="#3B4A6B" transform="rotate(15 70 60)"/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <g>
    <!-- Left page -->
    <polygon points="30,50 50,54 50,74 30,70" fill="#F7F3E8" stroke="#DDD5C0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Right page -->
    <polygon points="50,54 70,50 70,70 50,74" fill="#FFFDF5" stroke="#DDD5C0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Spine -->
    <line x1="50" y1="54" x2="50" y2="74" stroke="#C4A882" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Book cover edges -->
    <polygon points="28,50 30,50 30,70 28,70" fill="#D4534B"/>
    <polygon points="70,50 72,50 72,70 70,70" fill="#D4534B"/>
    <!-- Cover top and bottom edges -->
    <polygon points="28,50 72,50 70,50 30,50" fill="#D4534B"/>
    <polygon points="28,70 30,70 70,70 72,70" fill="#D4534B"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Text lines on left page -->
  <line x1="34" y1="57" x2="46" y2="59" stroke="#B0A890" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="61" x2="46" y2="63" stroke="#B0A890" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="65" x2="46" y2="67" stroke="#B0A890" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- Text lines on right page -->
  <line x1="54" y1="59" x2="66" y2="57" stroke="#B0A890" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="63" x2="66" y2="61" stroke="#B0A890" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="67" x2="66" y2="65" stroke="#B0A890" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="86" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="#F5A623"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="86" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="#F5A623"/>
</svg>
